name: Polivoks 1982
description: Independent circuit-informed emulation of the 1982 Formanta Polivoks: two free-running VCOs, K140UD12-style nonlinear state-variable filter, shared duophonic voice, looping ADSRs, four-shape LFO. Extras (velocity, pitch bend, key tracking) default to the 1982 behaviour.
author: bokontep
